bugs.title: Motor never starts when level begins at or above 25 cm
bugs.description: The only path into ST_RUN is the FILL branch at lines 77-80, and FILL is only entered from IDLE when levelCm < EMPTY_CM (10 cm) at lines 73-76. If the probe already reads at or above 25 cm while in IDLE, no branch fires, so state stays ST_IDLE and driveOutputs() at line 38 keeps D10 LOW; the engine measured D10 not HIGH for 4400 ms starting at 600 ms in the out-of-range high-level scenario and for 3400 ms starting at 600 ms in the max/min range scenario. D10 was in the wrong state for 3550 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.53 s: D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (grace 600 ms).
bugs.evidence: D10 was in the wrong state for 3550 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.53 s: D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (grace 600 ms).
